- name: int_jira__issue_lifecycle_analysis
      description: Issue lifecycle metrics and activity-based classifications derived from non-null field history changes
      grain: One row per issue_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Build issue_activity_history from staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history: - Keep only records where field_value is present. - For each issue_id, sort changes by updated_at ascending and derive: - previous_change_time: the timestamp of the immediately prior change for the same issue; null for the first change. - change_sequence: the 1-based position of the change in the sorted list. - total_changes: the total number of non-null field_value changes for the issue (reference only). - If multiple changes share an identical updated_at within an issue, their tie-order is implementation-dependent (no secondary tiebreaker). - Build activity_patterns by retaining only changes with a previous_change_time and compute: - days_between_changes: elapsed time in days between change_time and previous_change_time. - hours_between_changes: elapsed time in hours between change_time and previous_change_time (intermediate only; not output). - Summarize per issue_id (issue_activity_summary): - total_field_changes: the count of retained changes (number of consecutive intervals). - avg_days_between_changes: average of days_between_changes. - max_days_between_changes: maximum of days_between_changes. - activity_variance: standard deviation of days_between_changes. - first_change_time: earliest change_time among retained changes. - last_change_time: latest change_time among retained changes. - When no retained changes exist, the summary has no row; downstream metrics remain null, with total_field_changes set to 0 in the final step. - Build issue_base_info from staging.stg_jira__issue and compute: - total_lifecycle_days: elapsed time in days from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, to the current timestamp at execution. - Final integration and classifications (left join summary to base on issue_id): - total_field_changes: set to 0 when summary is missing; other summary metrics remain null when missing. - activity_pattern: - If total_field_changes = 0 → "No Activity". - Otherwise by avg_days_between_changes: ≤1 → "High Activity"; ≤7 → "Regular Activity"; ≤30 → "Low Activity"; else → "Minimal Activity". - lifecycle_speed: - By total_lifecycle_days: ≤7 → "Fast"; ≤30 → "Normal"; ≤90 → "Slow"; else → "Very Slow". - risk_indicator (applied in order): - If total_lifecycle_days > 90 and total_field_changes < 5 → "Stagnant". - Else if max_days_between_changes > 30 → "Inactive Periods". - Else if total_field_changes > 50 → "Over Worked". - Else → "Normal". - Output one row per issue_id from staging.stg_jira__issue; the final result is ordered by issue_id ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary grouping key from Jira; exactly one output row per issue_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable Jira issue key (e.g., PROJ-123)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type identifier from Jira
      - name: priority_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from Jira
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from Jira
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue creation timestamp from Jira
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue resolution timestamp; null if unresolved
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current assignee user identifier from Jira
      - name: reporter_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from Jira
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Fractional days from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, to current_timestamp at execution; no rounding
      - name: total_field_changes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of consecutive change intervals (rows with non-null previous_change_time) over non-null field_value changes; 0 when none
      - name: avg_days_between_changes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average of days_between_changes across change intervals; unit: days; null when no intervals'
      - name: max_days_between_changes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Maximum of days_between_changes across change intervals; unit: days; null when no intervals'
      - name: activity_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of days_between_changes across change intervals; null when no intervals
      - name: first_change_time
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest change_time among intervals (second or later change); null when no intervals
      - name: last_change_time
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest change_time among intervals; null when no intervals
      - name: activity_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: No Activity if total_field_changes=0; else High/Regular/Low/Minimal based on avg_days_between_changes thresholds'
        tests:
        - activity_pattern IN ('No Activity', 'High Activity', 'Regular Activity', 'Low Activity', 'Minimal Activity')
      - name: lifecycle_speed
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification from total_lifecycle_days: Fast (≤7), Normal (≤30), Slow (≤90), else Very Slow'
        tests:
        - lifecycle_speed IN ('Fast', 'Normal', 'Slow', 'Very Slow')
      - name: risk_indicator
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk classification applied in order: Stagnant, then Inactive Periods, then Over Worked, else Normal'
        tests:
        - risk_indicator IN ('Normal', 'Stagnant', 'Inactive Periods', 'Over Worked')

- name: int_jira__pivot_daily_field_history
      description: Daily pivot of latest status, sprint, story points, and story point estimate per issue on days with changes
      grain: One row per issue_id per valid_starting_on (only days with a change in any pivoted field)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_field_history
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_multiselect_history
      business_logic: '- Read single-value field changes from intermediate.int_jira__issue_field_history and multiselect field changes from intermediate.int_jira__issue_multiselect_history. - For multiselect changes, aggregate all values per (field_id, field_name, issue_id, updated_at) into one string joined by ", "; duplicates are preserved; NULL inputs are excluded; no ordering is enforced in the concatenation. - Union the aggregated multiselect changes with the single-value changes. - For each issue and field, each change timestamp starts a validity period that lasts until the next change; also derive the calendar date of the start. - Keep only relevant fields: status by field_id (case-insensitive), and sprint, story points, story point estimate by field_name (case-insensitive). - For each issue, field, and calendar date, retain the last change of that day (the highest change timestamp for that day; no tie-breaker beyond timestamp). - Replace a NULL field value with the literal "is_null"; otherwise keep the original text (including any comma-joined multiselect values). - Pivot to columns: status from field_id; sprint, story points, and story point estimate from field_name. Group by issue and date, and carry the week-start of the selected change timestamp. Use max as a pass-through since there is at most one selected value per field per day. - Output includes only dates where at least one relevant field changed for the issue. Unchanged fields on that date remain NULL; fields changed to true NULL appear as "is_null". - Compute issue_day_id as the MD5 of valid_starting_on concatenated with issue_id, with no delimiter.'
      columns:
      - name: valid_starting_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date on which the day's selected field updates became valid
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Jira issue identifier for the daily pivot row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: valid_starting_at_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Week start date based on the selected change timestamp for the day
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest status recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest status was NULL; otherwise NULL when status did not change that day
      - name: sprint
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest sprint value(s) recorded that day as a comma-separated list; 'is_null' if the latest sprint was NULL; otherwise NULL when sprint did not change that day
      - name: story_points
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest 'story points' recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest value was NULL; otherwise NULL when it did not change that day
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest 'story point estimate' recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest value was NULL; otherwise NULL when it did not change that day
      - name: issue_day_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of valid_starting_on and issue_id concatenated with no delimiter
        tests:
        - not_null

Derive velocity trends per project: - issues_resolved_30d counts issues resolved in the last 30 days; issues_created_30d counts issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_7d counts issues resolved in the last 7 days. - issues_resolved_prev_30d counts issues resolved 60–30 days before today. Compute quality indicators: - bug_issues counts issues with a non-null issue_type_id; feature_issues uses the same proxy and equals bug_issues. - reopened_issues_count counts all history records whose field value contains “reopen” (case-insensitive). - avg_comments_per_issue averages per-issue comment counts over issues that have at least one comment; NULL if none. Compute team dynamics: - workload_distribution_stddev and max_user_issues are derived from per-assignee issue counts on assigned issues; NULL if no assigned issues. - total_issue_links equals 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0. - sprints_participated equals the number of distinct sprints in the sprint source and is the same for all projects. Assemble risk flags (0/1): - backlog_risk = 1 if open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues else 0. - velocity_risk = 1 if avg_resolution_days > 30 else 0; NULL avg does not trigger the flag. - quality_risk = 1 if bug_issues > 30% of total_issues else 0. - resource_risk = 1 if unique_assignees < 2 else 0. - throughput_risk = 1 if issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d else 0. Compute health scores (each bounded to 0–25): - delivery_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 8 for backlog_risk, 10 for velocity_risk, 7 for throughput_risk. - quality_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 12 for quality_risk, 8 if reopened_issues_count > 10% of total_issues, 5 if avg_comments_per_issue < 1. - team_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 15 for resource_risk, 5 if workload_distribution_stddev > 10, 5 if unique_assignees = 0. - process_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues. - velocity_change_percent is the percent change in resolved count vs the prior 30 days; if the prior is 0 then 0; otherwise rounded to one decimal place. - name: int_jira__sprint_performance_analytics
      description: Advanced sprint performance analytics with start/end snapshots, burndown, velocity trends, and risk/health classification
      grain: 'One row per sprint_id per generated snapshot (at most two: start and end/complete)'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__field
      business_logic: 'Data assembly: - From staging.stg_jira__sprint, keep sprints with started_at not null. Derive start_date = date(started_at), end_date = date(ended_at), complete_date = date(completed_at). - planned_duration_days = (ended_at - started_at) in days when both exist, else null. actual_duration_days = (completed_at - started_at) in days when both exist (not used later). Sprint issues: - Create sprint_issues by pairing issues with sprints (cross join) and keeping only issue rows where issue.created_at falls between sprint.started_at and coalesce(sprint.completed_at, sprint.ended_at, current_timestamp). Apply a global LIMIT 1000 without ordering, so metrics are based on an arbitrary subset of qualifying rows. - story_points per issue: take the latest active field value whose field name contains “story” and “point”; use the numeric value if the field is numeric or extract the first numeric substring; if unavailable/unparsable, default to 1. - time_spent_seconds and original_estimate_seconds default to 0 when null. Snapshots: - For each sprint, create: - Start snapshot: snapshot_date = start_date, day_number = 1 (always). - End snapshot: only when planned_duration_days > 1; snapshot_date = complete_date, else end_date, else current_date; day_number = planned_duration_days. Metrics per snapshot (group by sprint and snapshot): - total_story_points_committed: sum of story_points across all included issue rows (no de-duplication). - story_points_completed: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at date is on/before snapshot_date. story_points_remaining: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at is null or its date is after snapshot_date. - total_issues_committed: count of issue rows. issues_completed: count where resolved on/before snapshot_date. issues_remaining: count where unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date. - total_estimated_hours: sum(original_estimate_seconds)/3600.0. hours_spent_completed: sum(time_spent_seconds) for issues resolved by snapshot_date divided by 3600.0. total_hours_spent: sum(time_spent_seconds)/3600.0. Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.'
      columns:
      - name: sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint primary identifier used for grouping and ordering
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint name from staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Snapshot date (start_date; and end/complete/current_date when planned_duration_days > 1)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_number
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Snapshot index: 1 at start; planned_duration_days at end/complete; ordered ascending within each sprint'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - day_number >= 1
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Planned sprint duration in days as (ended_at − started_at)/86400; null if ended_at is null; non-negative when present
        tests:
        - planned_duration_days IS NULL OR planned_duration_days >= 0
      - name: total_story_points_committed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for included issue rows; defaults to 1 per issue when the field is missing or unparseable; no de-duplication
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_story_points_committed >= 0
      - name: story_points_completed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_completed >= 0
      - name: story_points_remaining
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_issues_committed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of included issue rows within the sprint window
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_issues_committed >= 0
      - name: issues_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_completed >= 0
      - name: issues_remaining
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_estimated_hours
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total original estimate hours across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_estimated_hours >= 0
      - name: hours_spent_completed
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent on issues resolved by snapshot_date (seconds summed for those issues and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - hours_spent_completed >= 0
      - name: total_hours_spent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_hours_spent >= 0
      - name: ideal_story_points_remaining
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ideal remaining story points based on a straight-line burndown from committed at day 1 to 0 at the end; if no planned duration, equals committed
        tests:
        - not_null
        - ideal_story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: daily_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in story_points_remaining since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be negative
      - name: completion_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: story_points_completed divided by committed; 0 when committed is 0; range [0,1]'
        tests:
        - completion_ratio >= 0 AND completion_ratio <= 1
      - name: timeline_progress_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: day_number divided by planned_duration_days when planned_duration_days > 0, else 1; may exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1'
        tests:
        - timeline_progress_ratio >= 0
      - name: scope_change_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in committed story points since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: scope_change_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Change in committed issue count since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: burndown_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Difference between actual remaining and ideal remaining story points; positive means behind ideal, negative means ahead
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: performance_index
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of completion to timeline progress when progress is > 0; null otherwise; values > 1 indicate ahead of timeline
      - name: velocity_trend_3d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots within the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values
      - name: predicted_completion_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Forecasted completion snapshot index: current day_number plus remaining divided by daily_velocity when both positive; otherwise null'
        tests:
        - predicted_completion_day IS NULL OR predicted_completion_day > day_number
      - name: sprint_risk_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label based on completion vs timeline thresholds and scope change: Behind/Ahead/Scope Creep/On Track'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score from 0 to 100 using penalties for risk and variance and bonuses for positive indicators, clamped to the range
        tests:
        - not_null
        - sprint_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: velocity_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Velocity tier from velocity_trend_3d: High/Good/Low/No Progress/Negative Velocity (Negative on null)'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_phase
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Phase bucket by timeline_progress_ratio: Early (≤0.3), Mid (≤0.6), Late (≤0.9), Final (>0.9)'
        tests:
        - not_null

Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.

- name: jira__issue_intelligence_analytics
      description: Advanced issue intelligence with anomaly detection, risk/opportunity scoring, predictions, and classification
      grain: One or more identical rows per issue_id (project-level self-join propagates duplicates)
      source_models:
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      business_logic: 'Build issue_enriched_base from marts.jira__issue_enhanced and compute: - total_lifecycle_days = days between created_at and resolved_at (or current time if unresolved) - assigned_duration_days = days between first_assigned_at and resolved_at (or current time) - Carry through count_comments, project/assignee fields, sprint flags Build issue_lifecycle_context from staging.stg_jira__issue providing default context per issue_id: - total_transitions=0; unique_statuses_visited=0; days_in_development=0; days_in_qa=0; days_in_intake=0 - regression_ratio=0.0; progress_efficiency=1.0; lifecycle_pattern=''Normal''; lifecycle_quality_score=75.0 - resolution_speed_category=''Standard Timeline''; high_complexity_risk=false Build issue_comparative_metrics via a self-join on project_id (ieb ⋈ ieb2): - Window metrics over ieb2 partitions: - project average/median/p75 lifecycle days by ieb.project_id - issue type average/median lifecycle days by ieb.issue_type - priority average lifecycle days by ieb.current_priority - assignee average lifecycle days and total issues by ieb.assignee_user_id - project average comments and issue type average comments - Note: The self-join creates multiple rows per issue_id; duplicates are preserved downstream Build issue_anomaly_detection by joining issue_enriched_base to issue_comparative_metrics on issue_id: - lifecycle_deviation_ratio = absolute difference from the project median lifecycle divided by that median (NULL if the median is 0 or NULL; non-negative otherwise) - type_deviation_ratio, assignee_deviation_ratio, comment_deviation_ratio computed similarly (not exposed) - lifecycle_outlier_status determined by thresholds: - more than 2×project p75 lifecycle → ''Statistical Outlier'' - more than 1.5×project p75 lifecycle → ''Above Normal Range'' - less than 0.5×project median lifecycle → ''Unusually Fast'' - else → ''Normal Range'' Build issue_risk_scoring by left joining lifecycle_context and anomaly_detection to issue_enriched_base: - age_risk_score: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days > 90 else 0 - process_risk_score: 15 if regression_ratio > 0.3 else 0 (NULL behaves as false → 0) - complexity_risk_score: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0 (NULL → 0) - engagement_risk_score: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0 - assignment_risk_score: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0 - deviation_risk_score: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio > 1 else 0 (NULL → 0) - collaboration_opportunity_score: 5 if count_comments > project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0 (NULL → 0) - efficiency_opportunity_score: 5 if total_lifecycle_days < project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0 (NULL → 0) - process_opportunity_score: 5 if progress_efficiency > 0.8 else 0 (NULL → 0) Build predictive_indicators from risk_scoring: - total_risk_score = sum of individual risk scores - total_opportunity_score = sum of opportunity scores - completion_probability: - resolved_at not null → 1.00 - else by total_lifecycle_days: ≤7→0.95; ≤14→0.85; ≤30→0.70; ≤60→0.50; ≤90→0.30; else 0.15 - predicted_completion_timeframe: - resolved_at not null → ''Already Completed'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' and assignee present → ''Within 1 Week'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Normal'' and assignee present → ''Within 2 Weeks'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Complex'' → ''Within 1 Month'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Problematic'' → ''Beyond 1 Month'' - assignee_name null → ''Requires Assignment'' - else → ''Unknown'' - recommended_action: - age_risk_score>0 and assignment_risk_score>0 → ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite'' - process_risk_score>0 → ''Review Process Issues'' - complexity_risk_score>0 → ''Break Down or Reassign'' - engagement_risk_score>0 → ''Encourage Collaboration'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Leverage Best Practices'' - unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>30 → ''Management Review Required'' - else → ''Monitor Progress'' Build intelligence_classification from predictive_indicators: - intelligence_score (0–100): start at 50, add 2×total_opportunity_score, subtract total_risk_score, add 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80, add 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then clamp to the 0–100 range - health_status by total_risk_score: ≥25 ''Critical''; ≥15 ''High Risk''; ≥8 ''Medium Risk''; >0 ''Low Risk''; else ''Healthy'' - strategic_importance: - current_priority with case-insensitive ''critical'' or ''high'' → ''Strategic'' - issue_type with case-insensitive ''epic'' → ''Strategic'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''High Value'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' → ''Best Practice'' - else → ''Standard'' - intervention_urgency: - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥25 → ''Immediate'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥15 → ''Within 24 Hours'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥8 → ''Within Week'' - else if total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Study for Replication'' - else → ''Regular Monitoring'' Final output preserves duplicates from the self-join and is ordered by intelligence_score DESC, total_risk_score DESC.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique issue identifier from jira__issue_enhanced; join key throughout; duplicates may exist
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from Jira (e.g., PROJ-123); source value preserved
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type label from source (e.g., Bug, Story, Epic); case and spacing preserved
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current workflow status from source; exact text preserved
      - name: current_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current priority from source; used for strategic importance classification (case-insensitive contains 'critical'/'high')
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source associated with the issue; text preserved
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current assignee display name; may be NULL; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Elapsed days from created_at to resolved_at (or current time if unresolved); fractional days preserved; non-negative
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Resolution timestamp; NULL for unresolved issues; drives completion_probability and timeframe
      - name: is_active_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether the issue is in an active sprint; value passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: lifecycle_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle pattern classification from context (default 'Normal'); may be NULL if context missing; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: lifecycle_quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Lifecycle quality score from context (default 75.0); boosts intelligence_score when >80; may be NULL
      - name: high_complexity_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicator from context of high complexity; NULL treated as false in scoring; contributes to complexity_risk_score
      - name: regression_ratio
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Ratio of regressions from context (default 0.0); NULL treated as not exceeding 0.3; contributes to process_risk_score
      - name: lifecycle_deviation_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute deviation from project median lifecycle normalized by that median; NULL if median is 0 or NULL; non-negative
      - name: lifecycle_outlier_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlier classification based on project p75/median: ''Statistical Outlier''|''Above Normal Range''|''Unusually Fast''|''Normal Range''; may be NULL if comparative metrics missing'
      - name: age_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for issue age: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>90 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for process regressions: 15 if regression_ratio>0.3 else 0; NULL regression_ratio yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: complexity_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for complexity: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0; NULL treated as false; always non-null'
      - name: engagement_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for low comment engagement: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: assignment_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for missing assignee: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0; always non-null'
      - name: deviation_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for lifecycle deviation: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio>1 else 0; NULL deviation yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: collaboration_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high comment activity: 5 if count_comments>project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0; NULL avg yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: efficiency_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for faster-than-typical resolution: 5 if total_lifecycle_days<project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0; NULL median yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high progress_efficiency: 5 if >0.8 else 0; NULL treated as 0; always non-null'
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of individual risk scores (age+process+complexity+engagement+assignment+deviation); integer; non-null
      - name: total_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of opportunity scores (collaboration+efficiency+process); integer; non-null
      - name: completion_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Probability of completion (resolved→1.00; else discrete thresholds by total_lifecycle_days: 0.95/0.85/0.70/0.50/0.30/0.15); non-null in [0,1]'
      - name: predicted_completion_timeframe
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Predicted timeframe: ''Already Completed''|''Within 1 Week''|''Within 2 Weeks''|''Within 1 Month''|''Beyond 1 Month''|''Requires Assignment''|''Unknown'' per lifecycle_pattern, assignee, and resolution'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation based on risk/opportunity: ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite''|''Review Process Issues''|''Break Down or Reassign''|''Encourage Collaboration''|''Leverage Best Practices''|''Management Review Required''|''Monitor Progress'''
      - name: intelligence_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Overall score in [0,100]: 50 + 2×total_opportunity_score − total_risk_score, plus 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80 and 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then capped to [0,100]'
      - name: health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Issue health classification by total_risk_score: ''Critical''|''High Risk''|''Medium Risk''|''Low Risk''|''Healthy'''
      - name: strategic_importance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Strategic label derived from priority, issue_type, opportunity, and lifecycle_pattern: ''Strategic''|''High Value''|''Best Practice''|''Standard'''
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention urgency: if unresolved and risk high then ''Immediate''/''Within 24 Hours''/''Within Week''; else if high opportunity then ''Study for Replication''; else ''Regular Monitoring'''

non-negative otherwise) - type_deviation_ratio, assignee_deviation_ratio, comment_deviation_ratio computed similarly (not exposed) - lifecycle_outlier_status determined by thresholds: - more than 2×project p75 lifecycle → 'Statistical Outlier' - more than 1.5×project p75 lifecycle → 'Above Normal Range' - less than 0.5×project median lifecycle → 'Unusually Fast' - else → 'Normal Range' Build issue_risk_scoring by left joining lifecycle_context and anomaly_detection to issue_enriched_base: - age_risk_score: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days > 90 else 0 - process_risk_score: 15 if regression_ratio > 0.3 else 0 (NULL behaves as false → 0) - complexity_risk_score: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0 (NULL → 0) - engagement_risk_score: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0 - assignment_risk_score: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0 - deviation_risk_score: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio > 1 else 0 (NULL → 0) - collaboration_opportunity_score: 5 if count_comments > project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0 (NULL → 0) - efficiency_opportunity_score: 5 if total_lifecycle_days < project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0 (NULL → 0) - process_opportunity_score: 5 if progress_efficiency > 0.8 else 0 (NULL → 0) Build predictive_indicators from risk_scoring: - total_risk_score = sum of individual risk scores - total_opportunity_score = sum of opportunity scores - completion_probability: - resolved_at not null → 1.00 - else by total_lifecycle_days: ≤7→0.95; ≤14→0.85; ≤30→0.70; ≤60→0.50; ≤90→0.30; else 0.15 - predicted_completion_timeframe: - resolved_at not null → 'Already Completed' - lifecycle_pattern='Efficient' and assignee present → 'Within 1 Week' - lifecycle_pattern='Normal' and assignee present → 'Within 2 Weeks' - lifecycle_pattern='Complex' → 'Within 1 Month' - lifecycle_pattern='Problematic' → 'Beyond 1 Month' - assignee_name null → 'Requires Assignment' - else → 'Unknown' - recommended_action: - age_risk_score>0 and assignment_risk_score>0 → 'Urgent: Assign and Expedite' - process_risk_score>0 → 'Review Process Issues' - complexity_risk_score>0 → 'Break Down or Reassign' - engagement_risk_score>0 → 'Encourage Collaboration' - total_opportunity_score>10 → 'Leverage Best Practices' - unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>30 → 'Management Review Required' - else → 'Monitor Progress' Build intelligence_classification from predictive_indicators: - intelligence_score (0–100): start at 50, add 2×total_opportunity_score, subtract total_risk_score, add 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80, add 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then clamp to the 0–100 range - health_status by total_risk_score: ≥25 'Critical'; ≥15 'High Risk'; ≥8 'Medium Risk'; >0 'Low Risk'; else 'Healthy' - strategic_importance: - current_priority with case-insensitive 'critical' or 'high' → 'Strategic' - issue_type with case-insensitive 'epic' → 'Strategic' - total_opportunity_score>10 → 'High Value' - lifecycle_pattern='Efficient' → 'Best Practice' - else → 'Standard' - intervention_urgency: - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥25 → 'Immediate' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥15 → 'Within 24 Hours' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥8 → 'Within Week' - else if total_opportunity_score>10 → 'Study for Replication' - else → 'Regular Monitoring' Final output preserves duplicates from the self-join and is ordered by intelligence_score DESC, total_risk_score DESC.

columns.name: issue_id
columns.description: Unique issue identifier from jira__issue_enhanced; join key throughout; duplicates may exist

columns.name: issue_key
columns.description: Human-readable issue key from Jira (e.g., PROJ-123); source value preserved

columns.name: issue_type
columns.description: Issue type label from source (e.g., Bug, Story, Epic); case and spacing preserved

columns.description: Current workflow status from source; exact text preserved

columns.name: current_priority
columns.description: Current priority from source; used for strategic importance classification (case-insensitive contains 'critical'/'high')

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name from source associated with the issue; text preserved

columns.name: assignee_name
columns.description: Current assignee display name; may be NULL; used in timeframe prediction

columns.name: total_lifecycle_days
columns.description: Elapsed days from created_at to resolved_at (or current time if unresolved); fractional days preserved; non-negative

columns.name: resolved_at
columns.description: Resolution timestamp; NULL for unresolved issues; drives completion_probability and timeframe

columns.name: is_active_sprint
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the issue is in an active sprint; value passed through from source (may be NULL)

columns.name: lifecycle_pattern
columns.description: Lifecycle pattern classification from context (default 'Normal'); may be NULL if context missing; used in timeframe prediction

columns.name: lifecycle_quality_score
columns.description: Lifecycle quality score from context (default 75.0); boosts intelligence_score when >80; may be NULL

columns.name: high_complexity_risk
columns.description: Indicator from context of high complexity; NULL treated as false in scoring; contributes to complexity_risk_score

columns.name: regression_ratio
columns.description: Ratio of regressions from context (default 0.0); NULL treated as not exceeding 0.3; contributes to process_risk_score

columns.name: lifecycle_deviation_ratio
columns.description: Absolute deviation from project median lifecycle normalized by that median; NULL if median is 0 or NULL; non-negative

columns.name: lifecycle_outlier_status
columns.description: Outlier classification based on project p75/median: 'Statistical Outlier'|'Above Normal Range'|'Unusually Fast'|'Normal Range'; may be NULL if comparative metrics missing

columns.name: age_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for issue age: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>90 else 0; always non-null

columns.name: process_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for process regressions: 15 if regression_ratio>0.3 else 0; NULL regression_ratio yields 0; always non-null

columns.name: complexity_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for complexity: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0; NULL treated as false; always non-null

columns.name: engagement_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for low comment engagement: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0; always non-null

columns.name: assignment_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for missing assignee: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0; always non-null

columns.name: deviation_risk_score
columns.description: Risk points for lifecycle deviation: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio>1 else 0; NULL deviation yields 0; always non-null

columns.name: collaboration_opportunity_score
columns.description: Opportunity points for high comment activity: 5 if count_comments>project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0; NULL avg yields 0; always non-null

columns.name: efficiency_opportunity_score
columns.description: Opportunity points for faster-than-typical resolution: 5 if total_lifecycle_days<project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0; NULL median yields 0; always non-null

columns.name: process_opportunity_score
columns.description: Opportunity points for high progress_efficiency: 5 if >0.8 else 0; NULL treated as 0; always non-null

columns.name: total_risk_score
columns.description: Sum of individual risk scores (age+process+complexity+engagement+assignment+deviation); integer; non-null

columns.name: total_opportunity_score
columns.description: Sum of opportunity scores (collaboration+efficiency+process); integer; non-null

columns.name: completion_probability
columns.description: Probability of completion (resolved→1.00; else discrete thresholds by total_lifecycle_days: 0.95/0.85/0.70/0.50/0.30/0.15); non-null in [0,1]

columns.name: predicted_completion_timeframe
columns.description: Predicted timeframe: 'Already Completed'|'Within 1 Week'|'Within 2 Weeks'|'Within 1 Month'|'Beyond 1 Month'|'Requires Assignment'|'Unknown' per lifecycle_pattern, assignee, and resolution

columns.name: recommended_action
columns.description: Action recommendation based on risk/opportunity: 'Urgent: Assign and Expedite'|'Review Process Issues'|'Break Down or Reassign'|'Encourage Collaboration'|'Leverage Best Practices'|'Management Review Required'|'Monitor Progress'

columns.name: intelligence_score
columns.description: Overall score in [0,100]: 50 + 2×total_opportunity_score − total_risk_score, plus 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80 and 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then capped to [0,100]

columns.name: health_status
columns.description: Issue health classification by total_risk_score: 'Critical'|'High Risk'|'Medium Risk'|'Low Risk'|'Healthy'

columns.name: strategic_importance
columns.description: Strategic label derived from priority, issue_type, opportunity, and lifecycle_pattern: 'Strategic'|'High Value'|'Best Practice'|'Standard'

columns.name: intervention_urgency
columns.description: Intervention urgency: if unresolved and risk high then 'Immediate'/'Within 24 Hours'/'Within Week'; else if high opportunity then 'Study for Replication'; else 'Regular Monitoring'

- name: jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights
      description: Stakeholder engagement analysis with interaction network metrics, scorecards, and strategic recommendations (one row per active Jira user)
      grain: One row per active stakeholder_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__user
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      business_logic: 'Build base activity for each active user (is_active = true): - Reporter metrics: unique issues reported and unique projects reported to; average lifecycle in days from creation to resolution, using current time for unresolved issues. - Assignee metrics: unique issues assigned and unique projects assigned to; average resolution time in days, using current time for unresolved issues. - Comment metrics: total comments authored; average comment length over authored comments. - Total projects involved: unique projects seen across the user’s reported or assigned issues (null projects excluded). Construct interaction network between commenters on the same issue: - Pair comments by different authors where the partner’s comment occurs on or after the author’s comment and within 7 days. - Aggregate per author–partner pair: unique issues discussed together; total interaction instances; average response time in hours (absolute time gap); average combined comment length; count of same-calendar-day interactions. - Compute interaction strength as interaction count, upweighted for broad discussions (>10 distinct issues) and for faster average responses (<24 hours). - Keep only pairs with at least 3 interaction instances. Compute stakeholder influence metrics by joining users to the interaction network: - Outbound (user as author): direct network connections (unique partners), average outbound interaction strength, and total outbound interaction strength. - Inbound (user as partner): total inbound interaction strength. - Cross-functional projects: unique projects tied to any issue the user reported or was assigned (nulls excluded). - Response pattern from average assigned resolution days: Rapid (≤7), Timely (≤14), Standard (≤30), else Slow; if no value, treat as Slow. Score engagement (each capped at 25): - Breadth: 3 points per project involved + 5 points per cross-functional project + up to 10 points for direct connections (maximum 25). - Depth: communication component (15 points if >100 comments, else comments ÷ 7) plus influence component (10 points if average outbound strength >50, else average outbound strength ÷ 5); capped at 25; if average outbound strength is null, depth is null. - Quality: responder class points (Rapid 15; Timely 10; Standard 5; Slow 0) plus 10 points if average outbound strength >30; capped at 25. - Impact: outbound influence tier (>500: 15; >200: 10; >50: 5; else 0) plus workload tier by issues assigned (>50: 10; >20: 7; >5: 3; else 0); capped at 25. Behavioral patterns and classifications: - Total engagement score = breadth + depth + quality + impact (0–100 when depth is present; null if depth is null). - Stakeholder archetype (first match): Power Collaborator (breadth ≥20 and depth ≥15); Quality Influencer (quality ≥20 and impact ≥15); Cross-Functional Coordinator (breadth ≥15 and projects involved ≥5); Deep Specialist (depth ≥20); High Impact Contributor (impact ≥20); Active Communicator (comments >100); Heavy Executor (issues assigned >20); Requirements Driver (issues reported >20); Network Hub (connections >10); else Standard Participant. - Influence level (first match): High (outbound influence >500 and connections >15); Medium (outbound influence >200 and connections >8); Low (outbound influence >50 or connections >3); else Minimal. - Engagement risk (first match): Disengagement Risk (total engagement <20); Delivery Risk (Slow responder and issues assigned >10); Overwhelm Risk (inbound influence more than double outbound); Isolation Risk (connections <2 and projects involved >1); else Healthy Engagement. Strategic insights: - Strategic value score (first match): 100 (Power Collaborator or Quality Influencer with High Influence); 85 (Cross-Functional Coordinator or High Impact Contributor with High/Medium Influence); 70 (Deep Specialist or Network Hub); 75 (High Influence); 60 (total engagement ≥70); 45 (≥50); else 30. - Recommended strategy (first match): Re-engagement Campaign; Performance Support; Workload Optimization; Network Integration; Leverage and Amplify (Power Collaborator); Strategic Partnering (Quality Influencer); Key Relationship Management (High Influence); else Standard Engagement. - Development opportunity (first match): Cross-Project Exposure (breadth <10 and depth ≥15); Communication Effectiveness Training (quality <10 and comments >50); Leadership Development (impact <10 and issues assigned >20); Network Building (connections <3); Cross-Functional Assignment (no cross-functional projects); else Advanced Leadership Opportunities. Final output: one row per active stakeholder_id with all fields above; rows are ordered by strategic value score descending, then total engagement score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: stakeholder_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active user_id serving as the stakeholder key; exactly one output row per stakeholder_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: user_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name for the stakeholder from the user source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issues_reported
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique issues the stakeholder reported; null issue_ids excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: issues_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique issues assigned to the stakeholder; null issue_ids excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_comments_authored
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total comments authored by the stakeholder; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_projects_involved
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique projects seen across the stakeholder’s reported or assigned issues; null projects excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: direct_network_connections
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique interaction partners from the filtered network (only pairs with at least 3 interactions); returns 0 if none
      - name: response_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Assignee resolution speed class: Rapid (≤7d), Timely (≤14d), Standard (≤30d), else Slow; null values treated as Slow'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_outbound_influence_strength
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interaction strength across outbound connections; excludes nulls; null if no outbound interactions
      - name: total_outbound_influence
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total interaction strength across outbound connections; null if no outbound interactions
      - name: total_inbound_influence
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total interaction strength across inbound connections (where the stakeholder is the partner); null if no inbound interactions
      - name: cross_functional_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique projects for issues where the stakeholder is reporter or assignee; null projects excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: engagement_breadth_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 0–25, calculated as 3 points per project involved + 5 per cross-functional project + up to 10 for direct connections; capped at 25; never null
      - name: engagement_depth_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 0–25, sum of a communication component (15 if comments >100 else comments ÷ 7) and an influence component (10 if avg strength >50 else avg strength ÷ 5); capped at 25; null if average outbound strength is null
      - name: engagement_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25, responder class points (Rapid 15, Timely 10, Standard 5, Slow 0) plus 10 if average outbound strength >30; capped at 25; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_impact_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25, sum of outbound influence tier (>500:15, >200:10, >50:5, else 0) and issues-assigned tier (>50:10, >20:7, >5:3, else 0); capped at 25; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of breadth, depth, quality, and impact (0–100 when depth is present); null if engagement_depth_score is null
      - name: stakeholder_archetype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered classification: Power Collaborator, Quality Influencer, Cross-Functional Coordinator, Deep Specialist, High Impact Contributor, Active Communicator, Heavy Executor, Requirements Driver, Network Hub, else Standard Participant'
        tests:
        - not_null

specification.name: jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights
specification.description: Stakeholder engagement analysis with interaction network metrics, scorecards, and strategic recommendations (one row per active Jira user)
specification.business_logic: Build base activity for each active user (is_active = true): - Reporter metrics: unique issues reported and unique projects reported to; average lifecycle in days from creation to resolution, using current time for unresolved issues. - Assignee metrics: unique issues assigned and unique projects assigned to; average resolution time in days, using current time for unresolved issues. - Comment metrics: total comments authored; average comment length over authored comments. - Total projects involved: unique projects seen across the user’s reported or assigned issues (null projects excluded). Construct interaction network between commenters on the same issue: - Pair comments by different authors where the partner’s comment occurs on or after the author’s comment and within 7 days. - Aggregate per author–partner pair: unique issues discussed together; total interaction instances; average response time in hours (absolute time gap); average combined comment length; count of same-calendar-day interactions. - Compute interaction strength as interaction count, upweighted for broad discussions (>10 distinct issues) and for faster average responses (<24 hours). - Keep only pairs with at least 3 interaction instances. Compute stakeholder influence metrics by joining users to the interaction network: - Outbound (user as author): direct network connections (unique partners), average outbound interaction strength, and total outbound interaction strength. - Inbound (user as partner): total inbound interaction strength. - Cross-functional projects: unique projects tied to any issue the user reported or was assigned (nulls excluded). - Response pattern from average assigned resolution days: Rapid (≤7), Timely (≤14), Standard (≤30), else Slow; if no value, treat as Slow. Score engagement (each capped at 25): - Breadth: 3 points per project involved + 5 points per cross-functional project + up to 10 points for direct connections (maximum 25). - Depth: communication component (15 points if >100 comments, else comments ÷ 7) plus influence component (10 points if average outbound strength >50, else average outbound strength ÷ 5); capped at 25; if average outbound strength is null, depth is null. - Quality: responder class points (Rapid 15; Timely 10; Standard 5; Slow 0) plus 10 points if average outbound strength >30; capped at 25. - Impact: outbound influence tier (>500: 15; >200: 10; >50: 5; else 0) plus workload tier by issues assigned (>50: 10; >20: 7; >5: 3; else 0); capped at 25. Behavioral patterns and classifications: - Total engagement score = breadth + depth + quality + impact (0–100 when depth is present; null if depth is null). - Stakeholder archetype (first match): Power Collaborator (breadth ≥20 and depth ≥15); Quality Influencer (quality ≥20 and impact ≥15); Cross-Functional Coordinator (breadth ≥15 and projects involved ≥5); Deep Specialist (depth ≥20); High Impact Contributor (impact ≥20); Active Communicator (comments >100); Heavy Executor (issues assigned >20); Requirements Driver (issues reported >20); Network Hub (connections >10); else Standard Participant. - Influence level (first match): High (outbound influence >500 and connections >15); Medium (outbound influence >200 and connections >8); Low (outbound influence >50 or connections >3); else Minimal. - Engagement risk (first match): Disengagement Risk (total engagement <20); Delivery Risk (Slow responder and issues assigned >10); Overwhelm Risk (inbound influence more than double outbound); Isolation Risk (connections <2 and projects involved >1); else Healthy Engagement. Strategic insights: - Strategic value score (first match): 100 (Power Collaborator or Quality Influencer with High Influence); 85 (Cross-Functional Coordinator or High Impact Contributor with High/Medium Influence); 70 (Deep Specialist or Network Hub); 75 (High Influence); 60 (total engagement ≥70); 45 (≥50); else 30. - Recommended strategy (first match): Re-engagement Campaign; Performance Support; Workload Optimization; Network Integration; Leverage and Amplify (Power Collaborator); Strategic Partnering (Quality Influencer); Key Relationship Management (High Influence); else Standard Engagement. - Development opportunity (first match): Cross-Project Exposure (breadth <10 and depth ≥15); Communication Effectiveness Training (quality <10 and comments >50); Leadership Development (impact <10 and issues assigned >20); Network Building (connections <3); Cross-Functional Assignment (no cross-functional projects); else Advanced Leadership Opportunities. Final output: one row per active stakeholder_id with all fields above; rows are ordered by strategic value score descending, then total engagement score descending.

- name: jira__team_performance_dashboard
      description: Team performance dashboard per user aggregated across all projects with activity, delivery, collaboration, growth, risk, and scoring metrics
      grain: One row per user_id (project_id='all_projects')
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__user_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__user
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__field
      - raw.issue_sprint_history
      business_logic: '- Build user_activity_summary: - Join user metrics to users on user_id; emit one row per user with project_id=''all_projects'' and project_name=''All Projects''. - Set current_engagement_tier=''Standard User'', current_pattern_type=''Regular User'', current_lifecycle_stage=''Stable''. - Set avg_daily_activity_score and avg_weekly_activity_score from average close time days; avg_consistency_score=0.7; last_active_date=current_date; active_days_count=30; churn_risk_days=0; productive_days=count_closed_issues; highly_active_days=count_closed_issues if >10 else 0. - Build team_collaboration_metrics from issues created in the last 90 days and with a non-null assignee: - Group by project_id and assignee_user_id. - total_assigned_issues counts assigned issues. - resolved_issues counts assigned issues with a resolution date. - avg_resolution_days averages the days between creation and resolution over resolved issues. - high_priority_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null priority. - bug_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null issue type (label is generic, not limited to “Bug”). - epic_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null parent issue. - Join issue links and count distinct linked issue references on both sides; join comments and count distinct non-assignee comment authors. - estimate_accuracy_ratio averages the absolute relative difference between time spent and original estimate over issues where both values are present and >0. - Build sprint_participation_analysis from recent sprints (started within 180 days), issues, and derived story points: - Parse numeric story points from active field history where the field name contains “story” and “point”; default to 1 when no number is found. - Group by sprint_id, sprint_name, assignee user_id, and project_id. - Measure issues_in_sprint, issues_completed_in_sprint (resolved within sprint window), total_story_points, story_points_completed_in_sprint, and avg_completion_day_in_sprint (days from sprint start to resolution when resolved on/before sprint end). - Build user_growth_metrics by left joining user_activity_summary to issues and comments: - Consider issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; and comments authored by the user. - first_issue_date is the earliest issue creation date; last_resolved_date is the latest resolution date. - days_since_first_issue is the days from current_date to first_issue_date. - issue_types_worked_on counts distinct issue types; priority_levels_handled counts distinct priorities; projects_contributed_to counts distinct projects. - issues_reported counts issues reported by the user; issues_commented_on counts distinct issues the user commented on. - Build team_performance_scoring by left joining user_activity_summary to team_collaboration_metrics, user_growth_metrics, and aggregated sprint metrics: - Aggregate sprint metrics per user and project: sprint_count (distinct sprints), avg_sprint_completion_rate (average of per-sprint completed/issues; sprints with zero issues are excluded), total_story_points_delivered (sum of completed story points). - Rounding and units: - avg_daily_activity_score and avg_weekly_activity_score are computed to two decimals but stored without fractional part due to column type. - consistency_percentage = avg_consistency_score × 100 rounded to one decimal. - resolution_rate_percentage = percentage of assigned issues resolved, rounded to one decimal; NULL if no assigned issues. - avg_resolution_days rounded to one decimal; NULL if no resolved issues. - estimate_accuracy_percentage = estimate_accuracy_ratio × 100 rounded to one decimal; NULL if no eligible issues. - Risk flags: at_churn_risk is true when churn_risk_days > 7; inactive_recently is true when current_date − last_active_date > 7 days; poor_estimation is true when estimate accuracy ratio > 2; all flags are always populated (no NULLs). - Note: Joins to collaboration and sprint metrics use (user_id, project_id); because project_id=''all_projects'', these often remain NULL. - Final scoring and tiering: - overall_performance_score clamps to 0–100 and sums components: - Delivery (40%): 40/30/20/10/0 points at resolution rate ≥90/≥75/≥60/≥40/else. - Activity (30%): 30/20/10/0 points for engagement tier Highly/Moderately/Lightly Active/else. - Quality (20%): 20/15/10/5 points for estimate accuracy in [80,120]/[70,130]/[60,140]/else. - Collaboration (10%): 10/7/5/0 points at unique collaborators ≥5/≥3/≥1/else. - performance_tier: Top Performer (score ≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement. - Final output is ordered by overall_performance_score descending, then project_name, then user_display_name.'

      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier; grouping key; exactly one output row per user_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from staging.stg_jira__user for the user_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from staging.stg_jira__user; may be NULL if not present
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'all_projects' emitted for every user row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'All Projects' emitted for every user row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: current_engagement_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Engagement tier label set to 'Standard User'; used in scoring only when equal to 'Highly Active', 'Moderately Active', or 'Lightly Active'
      - name: current_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Activity pattern label; constant 'Regular User'
      - name: current_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage label; constant 'Stable'
      - name: avg_daily_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part
      - name: avg_weekly_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part
      - name: consistency_percentage
        data_type: DECIMAL(12,1)
        description: Activity consistency expressed as a percentage rounded to one decimal; constant 70.0 in current logic
      - name: total_assigned_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues assigned to the user in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics due to project_id='all_projects'
      - name: resolved_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a resolution date in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics
      - name: resolution_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of assigned issues resolved in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if no assigned issues
      - name: avg_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from issue creation to resolution for resolved issues in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if none
      - name: high_priority_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null priority in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on overall_performance_score: Top Performer (≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement'
      - name: bug_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null issue type in the last 90 days (generic, not limited to 'Bug'); NULL when no match
      - name: epic_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null parent issue in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: estimate_accuracy_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average relative deviation between time spent and original estimate over issues with both values >0, expressed as a percentage and rounded to one decimal; higher is worse; NULL if no eligible issues
      - name: linked_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total distinct linked issue references (issue_id plus related_issue_id) for the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: unique_collaborators_on_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct non-assignee comment authors on the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: projects_contributed_to
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct projects across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none
      - name: issue_types_worked_on
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct issue types across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none
      - name: sprint_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct sprint count aggregated per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'
      - name: avg_sprint_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per-sprint completion ratio (completed issues divided by issues in sprint), excluding sprints with zero issues; NULL when no matching sprint data for the user and project
      - name: total_story_points_delivered
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points completed within sprints per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'
      - name: days_since_first_issue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days between current_date and the user's first observed issue creation date; NULL if the user has no issues
      - name: leadership_indicator
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues reported by the user; 0 if none
      - name: at_churn_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when churn_risk_days > 7; False otherwise; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: inactive_recently
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when current_date minus last_active_date exceeds 7 days; False otherwise; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: poor_estimation
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the estimate accuracy ratio exceeds 2; False otherwise or when unavailable; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score (0–100) from delivery, activity, quality, and collaboration components; clamped to 0–100 using defined thresholds
        tests:
        - not_null

NULL if no assigned issues. - avg_resolution_days rounded to one decimal; NULL if no resolved issues. - estimate_accuracy_percentage = estimate_accuracy_ratio × 100 rounded to one decimal; NULL if no eligible issues. - Risk flags: at_churn_risk is true when churn_risk_days > 7; inactive_recently is true when current_date − last_active_date > 7 days; poor_estimation is true when estimate accuracy ratio > 2; all flags are always populated (no NULLs). - Note: Joins to collaboration and sprint metrics use (user_id, project_id); because project_id='all_projects', these often remain NULL. - Final scoring and tiering: - overall_performance_score clamps to 0–100 and sums components: - Delivery (40%): 40/30/20/10/0 points at resolution rate ≥90/≥75/≥60/≥40/else. - Activity (30%): 30/20/10/0 points for engagement tier Highly/Moderately/Lightly Active/else. - Quality (20%): 20/15/10/5 points for estimate accuracy in [80,120]/[70,130]/[60,140]/else. - Collaboration (10%): 10/7/5/0 points at unique collaborators ≥5/≥3/≥1/else. - performance_tier: Top Performer (score ≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement. - Final output is ordered by overall_performance_score descending, then project_name, then user_display_name.

columns.description: Constant 'all_projects' emitted for every user row

columns.description: Constant 'All Projects' emitted for every user row

columns.description: Engagement tier label set to 'Standard User'; used in scoring only when equal to 'Highly Active', 'Moderately Active', or 'Lightly Active'

columns.name: current_lifecycle_stage
columns.description: Lifecycle stage label; constant 'Stable'

columns.name: avg_daily_activity_score
columns.description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part

columns.name: avg_weekly_activity_score
columns.description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part

columns.name: consistency_percentage
columns.description: Activity consistency expressed as a percentage rounded to one decimal; constant 70.0 in current logic

columns.name: total_assigned_issues
columns.description: Count of issues assigned to the user in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics due to project_id='all_projects'

columns.name: resolved_issues
columns.description: Count of assigned issues with a resolution date in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics

columns.name: resolution_rate_percentage
columns.description: Percentage of assigned issues resolved in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if no assigned issues

columns.name: avg_resolution_days
columns.description: Average days from issue creation to resolution for resolved issues in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if none

columns.name: high_priority_issues
columns.description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null priority in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics

columns.name: performance_tier
columns.description: Tier based on overall_performance_score: Top Performer (≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement

columns.name: bug_issues
columns.description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null issue type in the last 90 days (generic, not limited to 'Bug'); NULL when no match

columns.name: epic_issues
columns.description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null parent issue in the last 90 days; NULL when no match

columns.name: estimate_accuracy_percentage
columns.description: Average relative deviation between time spent and original estimate over issues with both values >0, expressed as a percentage and rounded to one decimal; higher is worse; NULL if no eligible issues

columns.name: linked_issues
columns.description: Total distinct linked issue references (issue_id plus related_issue_id) for the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match

columns.name: unique_collaborators_on_issues
columns.description: Distinct non-assignee comment authors on the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match

columns.name: projects_contributed_to
columns.description: Distinct projects across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none

columns.name: issue_types_worked_on
columns.description: Distinct issue types across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none

columns.name: sprint_count
columns.description: Distinct sprint count aggregated per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'

columns.name: avg_sprint_completion_rate
columns.description: Average per-sprint completion ratio (completed issues divided by issues in sprint), excluding sprints with zero issues; NULL when no matching sprint data for the user and project

columns.name: total_story_points_delivered
columns.description: Sum of story points completed within sprints per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'

columns.name: days_since_first_issue
columns.description: Days between current_date and the user's first observed issue creation date; NULL if the user has no issues

columns.name: leadership_indicator
columns.description: Count of issues reported by the user; 0 if none

columns.name: at_churn_risk
columns.description: True when churn_risk_days > 7; False otherwise; always populated

columns.name: inactive_recently
columns.description: True when current_date minus last_active_date exceeds 7 days; False otherwise; always populated

columns.name: poor_estimation
columns.description: True when the estimate accuracy ratio exceeds 2; False otherwise or when unavailable; always populated

columns.name: overall_performance_score
columns.description: Composite score (0–100) from delivery, activity, quality, and collaboration components; clamped to 0–100 using defined thresholds
